lines: 1 Rimh rimmei luangcbut nai, duc sihmei kandih thangc,
Duipui paengc thangc naimei kandic khou;
Heipui luangcbut thangc 0({ gaanv khat ’zwan tat kan the,
Nang khang, akhang, dihmei khang theih khang.
Lungning khou makumh ’ki akhaengv kancpui thiak 0({,
Lungchwn khou howna mikdui key e;
Ryanramei akhaengvna Pou Jisu theiclou the,
Ai kumhmei nwan phunghmei ta thuaklou khang.
2 Zauc lo, ngam lak sihna dih paap puatrith phungcna,
Sauh pyrun runmei pu tatpat the,
’Ritmei kros 0({ phungcna ’bum keyna, ryanrana,
Kalvari luangcbut thangc ku kan the.
3 Nking o, ai chu the, zotpi hianmei khwan 0({,
Pou ta kros khou hianbinna bam the;
Meic guay ({0 zauc bam khou kalvari Lauziu Nac,
Kros 0({ kaniw ({0 zaythau kan the.
4 Theihthiu laa bam khou nganv Kaipouc ta sinnui e,
Kamei nunc zaengsiina kap bam khou;
Heidi ryanra sihni Kakhwan karing pat mak,
Diwsiimei rimh rimmei luangcbut khou.
5 Neihriw nic zingc tan diu, baengla nic zay tan diu,
Gumeipu ta swluaimei nunc khou;
’Ki zauc lo, t’rou khou ({0 Ravguangc Lauziu Nac 0({,
